name: @listo/mqtt-client-block-ui
_comment_deps: The @listo/* deps are required so the MF shared-singleton factory in ui-core/mf.ts can resolve each package's version from its own package.json (via require.resolve). Source code must still import only from @listo/block-ui-sdk (the block author's facade) — these declare the MF surface, not the API surface.
